title: Starfall Command
description:
Humanity's last hope stands between the galaxy and total annihilation.

Take control of one of four unique starfighters and fight through relentless waves of enemy forces, elite squadrons, deadly mini-bosses, and four massive war machines — each with its own attack patterns, signature moves, and combat identity.

Master fast-paced arcade combat. Dodge aimed enemy fire, chain kills to charge your Mega Salvo — a devastating volley of 8 homing missiles that locks onto every target on screen — and fight your way to the ultimate AI threat known only as THE OVERMIND.

This is a shoot 'em up built to be felt: screen-shaking impacts, cinematic boss entrances, and a final battle that fills the screen with fire and dares you to find the way through.

FEATURES

⚔ Four distinct AI bosses — A methodical dreadnought, a darting predator, a swarm commander, and a three-phase final boss. Every fight is a different problem to solve, and every attack is telegraphed and fair.

🚀 The Mega Salvo — Earn it through 30 kills, then unleash 8 homing missiles that streak across the screen to separate targets. Your signature "oh yes" moment.

🎯 Normal & Hard difficulty — Tune the challenge. Hard throws faster, denser fire and fewer lives at veterans who want to sweat.

🛸 Four playable starfighters — Each with its own stats and feel, plus a secret unlockable ship for those who reach the end.

🎮 Full controller & keyboard support — Play your way, on gamepad or keyboard. Fully playable on Steam Deck.

♾ Endless Mode — Survive after the campaign for the high-score chase, with online-worthy score attack for the leaderboard hunters.

💥 Arcade to the core — Elite waves, mini-boss ambushes, upgrade pickups, and a difficulty curve that ramps from your first wave to the Overmind's last stand.

Can you survive long enough to defeat the Overmind and save the galaxy?
description_short: Pilot powerful starfighters, battle massive bosses, unleash devastating homing missiles, and defeat the Overmind in this fast-paced arcade sci-fi shoot 'em up.
